cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

mechanism: A grades its pupil memory-keeping and claims preserving even B gift proves A greater care.
confusable: Not only taking teaching credit: each pupil achievement becomes more caring labor credited to A.
comparison: Preservation of memories versus physical burden.
